title: EC 1.2.4: UMAP of Conjoint triad
caption: UMAP projection of all 1011 proteins in the EC 1.2.4 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.30. Axes have no units, and distances between far-apart clusters are not meaningful. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
